authorization: User explicitly authorized automatic use of the existing official Authenticator and Vega login for this validation task.
startupKeySteps: Observe the official window and select the exact model
Verify Simulator checked, Gem unchecked and Gen2 selected
Set 资源文件夹 to the profile resourceFolder
Check file presence without exposing its content
Start Vega and observe whether authorization actually succeeds
componentConfigLookup: <Vega.exe folder>\Resources\ComponentConfig.json: the copy Vega actually runs with and the only one Start-ModelValidation Prepare switches (2026-11-05: Prepare set it to Vega100, window title showed Vega100, login with it succeeded)

<Vega project>\Resources\ComponentConfig.json (parent of the bin folder, e.g. C:\AutoTest\workspaces\Vega_SW\Vega\Resources\ComponentConfig.json): fallback only when the build output has no copy; a differing SelectedToolType is logged as a warning
loginSteps: Read ComponentConfig.json in the componentConfigLookup order; its ToolConfigCollection.SelectedToolType is the model/version to select in the Authenticator
Select the SelectedToolType model; set Simulator, Gem and Gen from the RootCondition of that same ToolConfig, and set 机器ID from that profile's Machine ID
Open 超级用户密码 and click the official generation button
Read the password text box into memory only; do not copy it to the clipboard, logs, or the repository
Fill Vega login with user su and that password, then click 确认
Verify the Vega title contains su and device state is Idle
notes: Do not log passwords or key text
UIA set_value without normal focus/keyboard input did not reliably commit the login bindings; use click + type_text
For PromptNotification transient dialogs use the matching transient screenshot's local coordinates; parent-window element indexes may not be actionable
Refresh state after each action and after window bounds changes
MachineConfiguration_Default contains section references; materialize General settings before first boot and replace D:\Vega\Data with this profile's writable data directory
A valid startup key does not establish UI acceptance or hardware test coverage
